import json
import os
import urllib.request
import sys
import time

BASE_URL = "https://storage.googleapis.com/storage/v1/b/openpi-assets/o"
DOWNLOAD_BASE = "https://storage.googleapis.com/openpi-assets"
LOCAL_DIR = "/root/autodl-tmp/.cache/openpi/openpi-assets/checkpoints/pi0_base/params"
os.makedirs(LOCAL_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# List all files
url = f"{BASE_URL}?prefix=checkpoints/pi0_base/params&maxResults=1000"
with urllib.request.urlopen(url) as resp:
    data = json.loads(resp.read())
items = data.get("items", [])
total_size = sum(int(i.get("size", 0)) for i in items)
print(f"Total: {len(items)} files, {total_size/1024/1024:.1f} MB")

downloaded = 0
for i, item in enumerate(items):
    name = item["name"]  # e.g. "checkpoints/pi0_base/params/_METADATA"
    size = int(item.get("size", 0))
    rel_path = name.replace("checkpoints/pi0_base/params/", "")
    local_path = os.path.join(LOCAL_DIR, rel_path)
    
    # Skip if already downloaded with correct size
    if os.path.exists(local_path) and os.path.getsize(local_path) == size:
        downloaded += size
        print(f"[{i+1}/{len(items)}] SKIP {rel_path} ({size/1024/1024:.1f} MB)")
        continue
    
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(local_path), exist_ok=True)
    dl_url = f"{DOWNLOAD_BASE}/{name}"
    
    t0 = time.time()
    try:
        urllib.request.urlretrieve(dl_url, local_path)
        dt = time.time() - t0
        speed = size / 1024 / 1024 / max(dt, 0.001)
        downloaded += size
        print(f"[{i+1}/{len(items)}] OK {rel_path} ({size/1024/1024:.1f} MB, {speed:.1f} MB/s) [{downloaded/1024/1024:.0f}/{total_size/1024/1024:.0f} MB]")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[{i+1}/{len(items)}] FAIL {rel_path}: {e}")
